data: Amazon's net sales were **$574.8 billion in fiscal 2023** and about **$716.9 billion in fiscal 2025**, an increase of roughly **24.7%** over the two years. Amazon's fiscal year matches the calendar year. Between those years, fiscal 2024 revenue was $638.0 billion, so growth was about 11% in 2024 and about 12% in 2025. The 2023 figure is well established. The 2025 figure is from my memory of Amazon's fourth-quarter 2025 earnings release in early 2026, and I couldn't check it against the filing here, so please confirm it in Amazon's 2025 Form 10-K before relying on it.
